name: Open Y Branch Selector
description: Lets a visitor save a branch location as "My YMCA" and links to it.
project_description:

 Branch selector is a small JavaScript library that sets cookies for the customer in order to use them in other parts of the site for content personalization.

 
 Read our instructions for getting started . 
 Search our documentation for assistance. 
 Review our Community Resources for more information. 
 
 Requirements 
 This project is meant to be used with the YMCA's Website Service distribution .
